bm_equipment_doctor_bag_desc: To use the Doctor Bag, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it can be used by you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to regain health. Using the doctor bag will give the player one life back, meaning the player can get downed once more before going into custody. It can only be used twice.$NL;$NL;When the Doctor Bag is consumed, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Doctor Bag. $NL;$NL;The Doctor Bag is a portable bag, usually used by a physician or other medical profession to transport medical supplies and medicine.
bm_equipment_grenade_case_desc: To use the Grenade Case, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it may be used by both you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to restore throwables. It can fully replenish your grenade reserves 4 times. When the Grenade Case is depleted, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Grenade Case. $NL;$NL;The Grenade Case is a portable case carried by combat operatives to transport explosives and other throwable weapons into a battle zone.
bm_equipment_grenade_crate_desc: To use the Ordnance Bag, you need to place it by holding $BTN_USE_ITEM;. Once placed it cannot be moved, but it may be used by both you and your crew by holding $BTN_INTERACT; to restore throwables. It can fully replenish your grenade reserves 4 times. When the Ordnance Bag is depleted, it disappears. You can see how many uses are left by looking at the Ordnance Bag. $NL;$NL;The Ordnance Bag is a portable case carried by combat operatives to transport explosives and other throwable weapons into a battle zone.
